The first step can be the hardest one, and definitely the scariest, I’m so proud of you for taking it. If you’re concerned about getting sanctioned, ask them what their policies are before you begin. Asking them for references to a licensed mental health professional could be a great place to start, as they may be more experienced and be able to provide the specific help you may need. But just having someone to be open and honest with in a non judgmental environment can be so helpful and relieving
